rule_check.source: Craswell et al. 2021, SIGIR, doi:10.1145/3404835.3463249, Sec. 3.2: the 2019 judgment process was reused in 2020; thresholds from the 2019 overview (arXiv 2003.07820)
rule_check.verdict: consistent with every released unit; excluded units cannot be checked (no published judgments)

scope_statement: Comparisons on TREC DL 2020 passage license claims about the queries it can evaluate, which leave out 73.0% of the 200 TREC DL 2020 passage test topics. Within each evaluated query, 99.9958% to 99.9983% of the 8,841,823 documents are unjudged and count as non-relevant. The stated rule (>= 3 relevant (grade >= 2) and relevant/judged < 0.6) is consistent with every released unit; excluded units cannot be checked (no published judgments).

support.basis: Only topics with judgments are scored, so a released test topic without judgments is never evaluated; inside a topic, unjudged documents count as non-relevant.
support.candidates: the judged topics; within a topic, every corpus document
